name: King Narfi
description: A frozen mummy king of Karfell with an army of Dread Marn who agreed to keep Valki imprisoned in return for first pick of treasure at the Doomskar.

description_citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
timeline.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt imprisons Valki in Karfell and assumes his identity, spreading chaos across the realms.
timeline.quote: Tibalt deceived the god Valki and imprisoned him in magical chains

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: King Narfi betrays his people and leads the god of death to transform Karfell's nobles and subjects into undead draugr.
timeline.quote: King Narfi betrayed his people and led the god of death to transform all Karfell's nobles and their subjects into undead.

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
